permitted.final_test: assignment IDs and byte hashes only

access.routing: Full CSV row strings traversed; route by ID before numeric/outcome conversion

descriptive_analysis.case_selection_rule: 0.5 classification; highest p for correct default/false alarm, lowest p for correct nondefault/missed default; ties lowest client_id

logistic.category_reference_rule: first (lowest) fitted category, explicit coefficient difference
logistic.interpretation: conditional associations in a regularized fitted model; not causal effects
logistic.numeric_scale: one development-training standard deviation after median imputation

slices.calibration_summary: mean predicted risk minus observed prevalence (calibration in the large)
slices.limitations: historical descriptive associations; neither fairness nor causal evidence
slices.suppressed_fields: all rates and probability summaries; retain counts

utilization_bands.tie_rule: cutpoint values go to the higher band; duplicate quartiles may yield empty bands

shap.dependence_selection: top two mean absolute SHAP values on fixed development sample; feature name tie break
shap.limitations: Correlated histories may share attribution. SHAP is not causal and raw-tree values do not explain the chosen probability mapping.
